$comment: Install receipt of the quenching-management method — TEMPLATE. Written/updated by the method at every install/upgrade (Steps 5/7); committed at the target's .claude/quenching-manifest.json. It is the join key between the target's installed copies and the package: the re-audit reconcile scope reads it to classify each entry (Current/Upgradable/Adapted/Rotted/Orphaned — references/lifecycle.md §2). Fill placeholders on first install; NEVER hand-maintain the artifacts list — the method owns it. 'mode' and 'channel' are the only fields the human flips by hand (consent grant/revoke, lifecycle.md §3-4).

artifacts.$comment: One entry per installed artifact. id = payload path inside the package (stable join key). version = package version that stamped it (use "unknown" for a backfilled untracked install — a bare copy's stamping version is unknowable; reconcile treats "unknown" as Upgradable, lifecycle.md §2). dest = where it landed in THIS repo. adaptations = every deliberate divergence from the payload (rename, path repoint, config values) — re-applied on upgrade; an unrecorded divergence is surfaced as 'Adapted' by the reconcile. Translating an audience: agent/both payload is NOT an adaptation — the agent-facing surface stays English.
